name: n8n Lead Log to Google Sheets
description: Validates a webhook lead payload, removes unexpected fields, and appends an approved lead summary to a Google Sheet for a small sales team.

steps.description: Receive the lead payload through an authenticated or unguessable webhook endpoint.
Reject malformed requests and keep only the fields approved for the sales spreadsheet.
Search the configured identifier to avoid creating repeated lead records.
Write the sanitized lead summary and a server-generated timestamp to the target sheet.

privacy.notes: Restrict spreadsheet access, minimize collected fields, define a retention period, and keep credentials in n8n credential storage rather than workflow JSON.

testing: Send a valid synthetic payload and confirm the approved fields are appended once.
Send the same payload twice and confirm duplicate detection prevents a second row.
Send an unexpected private field and verify it is removed before the spreadsheet write.
